prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: environment-only playable combat room reference for a warm fantasy isometric action RPG starring a red panda shopkeeper.
Create one exceptionally polished wide 16:9 image of a spacious AMBER MINE HALL, a real in-engine gameplay camera view from a fixed elevated oblique angle about 50 degrees, not a miniature diorama or cinematic illustration.
Scene and layout: an expansive level stone-paved underground mining hall, flat open combat floor covering at least 65 percent of the view, floor extending beyond the foreground and sides of the image. Heavy modular stone tiles with subtle imperfect bevels and occasional mineral streaks. Natural carved rock and wood support beams around the perimeter. Two clearly visible broad walkable exits, one upper-left and another upper-right leading into passages, both connected across the open battle space. Small edge clusters of woven ore baskets, a low wooden mine cart, a couple crates and a few restrained golden-brown amber mineral crystals. A narrow short decorative mine rail hugs one side and never cuts across the middle fighting space. No central clutter.
Style: high-quality stylized fantasy 3D game graphics, believable physically based stone, warm timber and lightly worn iron. Crisp modeled geometry, restrained hand-crafted proportion exaggeration, realistic roughness variation, fine contact shadows, soft indirect illumination. Cozy adventurous atmosphere with rich but restrained colors and readable navigation. A sophisticated Blender/Godot realtime look, grounded and tactile rather than cartoon flat shading.
Lighting: a broad fissure above lets angled afternoon gold sunbeams reach the stone floor, subtle volumetric dust beams, warm lantern pools at edges, soft low-saturation teal-gray bounce in shadows, detailed high quality ambient occlusion. All walkable space is clearly exposed and readable, moderate dynamic range, no blown-out whites or blacked-out floor.
Composition: camera far enough back to show a large encounter area, no horizon, no low camera, no depth of field, visually crisp throughout. Buildings/rock framing do not enclose all four sides of the frame; no floating island border or cutaway box. Environment only; absolutely no people, red panda, creatures, HUD, words, labels, watermark, grid overlay, panel frame, attack effects, particle combat effects or collage.
Avoid: post-apocalypse, ruined wasteland, horror, modern industrial machinery, lava, deep pits, dangerous holes, giant statues or central pillar obstruction, excessive crystals, clutter in the central battlefield.
visual_check: Open central stone floor well above 65%, two broad exits, edge-only rails and props, warm amber sunlight and lantern lighting; environment only, no UI or characters.
